product.title: 'Auana by Cirque du Soleil at the Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel

description.text: 'Auana is a Cirque du Soleil show at the OUTRIGGER Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel in Honolulu. The show is presented only at the OUTRIGGER Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel.
